query:
UPDATE character
        SET
            name = $2,
            name_native = $3,
            description = $4,
            favorites = $5,
            version = $6,
            merged_record_hash = $7,
            hash_format = $8,
            merge_version = $9,
            merge_requested_at = NULL,
            merged_at = COALESCE(merged_at, $10),
            updated_at = $10
        WHERE id = $1
